meta.title: Cancel a purchase
meta.description: Cancel a purchase made on this site: your rights, the ways to reach us and the online cancellation form.

page.title: Cancel a purchase
page.intro: You can cancel the purchase of a work bought on this site. You may give notice in any of the ways listed here; every notice we receive is recorded and acknowledged.
page.draft: Draft – this wording has not yet been approved by a lawyer.
page.rights14: You may cancel within 14 days of receiving the work or the disclosure document, whichever is later. You may also cancel before the work is delivered.
page.rights4m: Senior citizens (65+), people with disabilities and new immigrants (up to 5 years): if the purchase involved a conversation with the seller, you may cancel within 4 months.
page.rightsFee: A cancellation that is not due to a defect or a mismatch may carry a fee of up to 5% of the price or ₪100, whichever is lower.
page.rightsRefund: Refunds are made within 14 days of receiving your notice, to the original payment method. If the work was already delivered, we will send return instructions.
page.channelForm: With the online form on this page
page.formIntro: For Israeli consumers, your full name and ID number are enough. You may give your order number instead.
page.privacy: We collect these details to handle and record your cancellation notice as the law requires. You are not legally required to provide them, but without a name and an identifier (ID, passport or order number) we cannot identify the purchase. Your ID number is stored encrypted and never shown in full. Your details are not shared, except with the payment provider for the refund.

form.idHint: Leave empty if you give the order number.
form.orderHint: For example GG-7K3M9Q. Leave empty if you give your ID number.
form.eligibleGroup: Eligibility for the extended cancellation period
form.eligibleHint: Only if the purchase involved a conversation with the seller (for example a question before buying).

admin.newIntro: Notices by phone, email, registered mail or in person. Record the actual time it was received: the 14 days for the refund count from it.
